description: You can pass two different functions through the same Mini call.

steps.description: apply takes a function f and a value x. You return the result of calling f with x.
square multiplies n by itself. Passing square and 7 to apply produces the printed value 49.

steps.answer: It calls double(8), whose body multiplies 8 by 2. The result is 16.
steps.question: Which operation will apply perform when f is double and x is 8?

steps.description: You bind double to an anonymous function and pass it through apply. The output prints 16 after the earlier 49.

title: Passing functions to apply
